title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Rate Card: Block Sizes, Prices and Invoice Terms
content:
TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours is sold in six block sizes: the TimeBank 10-Hour Block, TimeBank 20-Hour Block, TimeBank 40-Hour Block, TimeBank 80-Hour Block, TimeBank 160-Hour Block and TimeBank 320-Hour Block. Each size carries the figures below. The list price of a block is its block hours times its effective prepaid hourly rate, before any discount.

| Figure | 10-Hour | 20-Hour | 40-Hour | 80-Hour | 160-Hour | 320-Hour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Block hours granted | 10 | 20 | 40 | 80 | 160 | 320 |
| Effective prepaid rate per block hour (USD) | 165.00 | 158.00 | 150.00 | 142.00 | 135.00 | 128.00 |
| List price before any discount (USD) | 1650.00 | 3160.00 | 6000.00 | 11360.00 | 21600.00 | 40960.00 |
| ClearPath discount off the list price (percent) | 0 | 0 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Lowest ClearPath tier rank that qualifies for that discount | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| What activates the block | full payment | full payment | full payment | full payment | signature | signature |
| Calendar days after the block invoice posts by which payment is due | 0 (due on receipt) | 0 (due on receipt) | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| Largest invoice that may be paid by card (USD) | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 |
| Signed order form required to order | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Active ClearPath agreement required to order | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |

## Notes on the figures

- The list price row equals the block hours row times the rate row for every size: for example, 40 hours at 150.00 is 6000.00.
- A ClearPath discount of 0 percent means the size carries no ClearPath discount, whatever ClearPath tier the client holds.
- The ClearPath tier rank runs from 1 for ClearPath Monitor to 6 for ClearPath Enterprise (ClearPath Monitor 1, ClearPath Essentials 2, ClearPath Standard 3, ClearPath Professional 4, ClearPath Premier 5, ClearPath Enterprise 6).
- An invoice-due figure of 0 means the block invoice is due on receipt.
